title: CYBRIK tool execution (invocation) result v1
description: Control-plane response to a tool execution request (strategy 05 §5.2). Maps to REST statuses: queued(202), completed(200), denied(403), approval_required(409), budget_exceeded(429), unavailable(503, no silent execution), failed. Output returned to the model is UNTRUSTED data (strategy 05 §11.6). No credential or unrestricted raw stdout is ever returned; large output is referenced by scoped locator + digest. The authoritative record of any side effect is the signed execution receipt referenced by receipt_id. Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA).

tenant_id.description: Advisory tenant of this result; the control plane derives the authoritative tenant from the credential. MUST equal the originating request's tenant_id (consistent cross-tenant binding).

receipt_id.description: Present when execution occurred (completed/failed with side effect). Dereference for the signed authoritative receipt.

policy_decision_id.description: Id of the policy decision that gated this invocation.

approval_id.description: Present when status=approval_required; correlates to the approval request.

output.description: Bounded, in-line result for small R0/read outputs. UNTRUSTED when returned to the model.

data.description: Capability-specific output, validated against the capability output_schema_ref.

output_artifacts.description: Scoped locators + digests for larger output. Locators are owner-issued, not arbitrary URLs.

error.description: Stable error families only (strategy 05 §8): AUTH_*, SCOPE_*, TENANT_*, CONTRACT_*, VALIDATION_*, BUDGET_*, RATE_*, FABRIC_POLICY_*, FABRIC_APPROVAL_*, FABRIC_EXECUTION_*, SANDBOX_*, ARTIFACT_*, DEPENDENCY_*. Never leak backend exceptions or cross-tenant resource detail.
